nodes.name: custom.py
nodes.summary: Hand-rolled reverse-mode autodiff: a Var computational-graph node whose arithmetic ops (+, *, sin) each record a per-node _backward gradient closure, and backward() topologically sorts the graph then runs the closures to accumulate gradients.
nodes.languageNotes: Each op stores a Python closure (_backward) as its gradient rule; backward() seeds the output's adjoint to 1.0 and traverses a reverse topological order — the minimal tensor-core of a deep-learning framework.

nodes.name: Var
nodes.summary: A node in the computational graph holding a value, an accumulated gradient (adjoint), its children, and a _backward closure; the + and * operators plus sin() build child nodes and attach the corresponding gradient-propagation closures.

nodes.name: backward
nodes.summary: Driver of reverse-mode autodiff: recursively builds a topological order of the graph, seeds the output's gradient to 1.0, then runs each node's _backward closure in reverse to accumulate df/dx for all leaf inputs.

nodes.name: pytorch.py
nodes.summary: Reference script mirroring custom.py with PyTorch: builds f=(x+y)·sin(x) on grad-tracking tensors, calls f.backward(), prints df/dx and df/dy, verifies them analytically, and shows one gradient-descent step on a weight vector.

nodes.name: tensorflow.py
nodes.summary: Reference script mirroring custom.py with TensorFlow: builds f=(x+y)·sin(x) under a GradientTape, calls tape.gradient, verifies the derivatives analytically, and shows one gradient-descent step on a weight variable.

nodes.name: pytorch.py
nodes.summary: Minimal-Neuron XOR demo built with Keras (despite the filename): constructs a one- or two-layer sigmoid model via build_tf_nn, fits it on the XOR truth table, and prints predictions for all four inputs.

nodes.name: build_tf_nn
nodes.summary: Builds a Keras Sequential model for XOR: a single sigmoid Dense layer when layers=1, or a 4-unit hidden ReLU layer plus a sigmoid output when layers=2; compiled with Adam and binary cross-entropy.

nodes.name: tensorflow.py
nodes.summary: Minimal-Neuron XOR demo written in PyTorch (filename is TensorFlow): defines a one- or two-layer NeuralNet, trains it 500 epochs with BCE loss and Adam on the XOR table, and prints a prediction for each input.

nodes.name: NeuralNet
nodes.summary: An nn.Module XOR network: a single Linear(2→1)+Sigmoid when layers=1, or Linear(2→4)+ReLU+Linear(4→1)+Sigmoid when layers=2.

nodes.name: pytorch.py
nodes.summary: PyTorch binary image classifier (VisionLab): defines a small SimpleCNN, trains it on an ImageFolder dataset with BCE loss, and exposes train/predict CLI modes that save and load the model plus a classes.json.

nodes.name: SimpleCNN
nodes.summary: A compact nn.Module CNN: Conv2d(3→32)+ReLU+MaxPool2d+Flatten feeding a Linear(76832→64)→ReLU→Linear(64→1)→Sigmoid head for binary classification of 100×100 RGB images.

nodes.name: train_mode
nodes.summary: Training loop: loads an ImageFolder with resize/to-tensor transforms, splits train/val when at least 5 images exist, runs 10 epochs of Adam+BCE with per-epoch loss logging, and saves the state_dict and classes.json.

nodes.name: predict_mode
nodes.summary: Inference: loads the saved model and classes.json, resizes/normalizes a single image, runs a no-grad forward pass, and reports the class name with a thresholded confidence.

nodes.name: tensorflow.py
nodes.summary: TensorFlow/Keras binary image classifier (VisionLab): builds a Rescaling→Conv2D→MaxPool→Flatten→Dense→Sigmoid model, trains it with an automatic validation split, and offers train/predict CLI modes that persist the model and classes.

nodes.name: build_model
nodes.summary: Assembles a Keras Sequential CNN (Rescaling 1/255, Conv2D 3→32 relu, MaxPooling2D 2×2, Flatten, Dense 64 relu, Dense 1 sigmoid) compiled with Adam and binary cross-entropy.

nodes.name: train_mode
nodes.summary: Training: counts dataset files to decide on a 20% validation split, streams image_dataset_from_directory, fits 10 epochs, and saves the model plus a classes.json of detected classes.

nodes.name: predict_mode
nodes.summary: Inference: loads the saved Keras model and classes.json, resizes an image to 100×100, predicts, and reports the class name with confidence, handling both binary sigmoid and multi-class softmax outputs.

nodes.name: qos.py
nodes.summary: AST-based Python quality checker: walks a directory of .py files, flags non-snake_case function names and unused imports via a custom NodeVisitor, and exits non-zero on any issue (acts as a CI smoke test).

nodes.name: QualityChecker
nodes.summary: An ast.NodeVisitor that records imported names (with line numbers) and used names, and collects issues such as function definitions that are not in snake_case.

nodes.name: run_smoke_test
nodes.summary: Walks a directory, parses each .py file, runs QualityChecker to detect unused imports and bad function names, prints FAIL/OK results, and exits 1 if any issue or syntax error is found.

nodes.name: zipf_data.py
nodes.summary: Data generator for the Zipf visualization: tokenizes Finnegans Wake and the King James Bible, computes word-frequency distributions, and writes lndw/zipf_data.json for the in-browser Zipf plot.

nodes.name: load_words
nodes.summary: Reads a text file, strips the KJV header and verse markers, and returns a list of lowercased words extracted by regex.

nodes.name: zipf_data
nodes.summary: Counts word frequencies with a Counter and returns the top words and their frequencies sorted by count (ties broken lexicographically) up to max_ranks.
